asr.full_text: This is Shah and Dogecoin is currently sitting at a very important level where the daily structure is deciding whether the market continues upward or shifts into a bearish move. Right now Dogecoin is trading around 0.091. In the last update we clearly marked the key support around 0.090. The plan was simple. As long as that support held on the daily time frame, the overall structure would remain bullish. But if the market started closing below that level, on daily candles, the structure would shift bearish. Since that update, we did see some temporary weakness on the lower time frame. On the 4-hour chart, a few candles closed below the 0.090 support. But this type of movement is actually normal and we have seen similar behavior in the past where lower time frame candles dip below support before the daily structure confirms the direction. That is why the daily time frame matters more in this situation. When we look at the daily chart only one candle managed to close below the 0.090 support. After that, the very next daily candle pushed back above the level and closed above it again. This is important because it means the level was quickly reclaimed. According to the two day confirmation idea we discussed earlier, the structure only turns properly bearish if the market continues closing below that level. Since the next candle reclaimed the support that bearish confirmation never happened. So for now, the theory still stands. The support is still technically holding on the daily time frame and the structure has not flipped bearish yet. As long as Dogecoin continues to hold above the 0.090 support, the bias remains towards the upside. If buyers maintain control of this level, the next upside target sits around 0.10, which is the next major resistance zone on the chart however there is also a clear invalidation level in this set up if dogecoin starts closing below the 0.090 support on the daily time frame and fails to reclaim it then the bullish structure would break in that scenario the market could start moving lower and the next support area to watch would be around 0.0 80 so the structure right now is very simple and clean support at 0.0 90 is the key level controlling the direction holding above it keeps the bullish scenario alive towards 0.10 while losing it on the daily timeframe could push the price down towards 0.080.
